audit.whatIsWrong: Three full-layer rows disagreed with the content layer: phases[3] and phases[5] read 'Skill' and phases[6] read 'Veigar', while content win[3], win[5] and win[6] and the whole packet chart read Katarina. The page also called a 55.48% matchup EVEN 5.5/10.
audit.why: Veigar is the least mobile champion in the lane with one defensive button on a 20s-to-14s cooldown; Katarina wins every stage, and the content layer's own why for row 6 says so explicitly ('your flanks and resets beat a one-cage immobile mage').
audit.corrected: All three sides aligned to Katarina with rewritten whys, and diff moved EVEN to FAVOURED at 4/10 to match the win rate and the chart.

audit.why: Levels 3-6 are the kill phase; first item is deny-scaling time; two items is the only row where Primordial Burst (120/90/60s) plus stacks becomes a real threat, and even there the answer is flanking rather than conceding the row.
audit.corrected: Ratings kept Katarina-favoured with the two-item row weakest.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and never named Event Horizon's real cooldown. Nothing on the page stated that Event Horizon cancels Death Lotus, and spikes[1] quoted a '16-second' E cooldown that is not a value the ability has at any rank.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s and is flagged hardCC; Death Lotus is flagged channel, so a cage dropped on a spinning Katarina ends the ultimate. Dark Matter has no base cooldown of its own — stacks shorten it. Primordial Burst is 120/90/60s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with the real numbers; the cage-cancels-Lotus interaction written into dontsFull[2]; the 16-second figure corrected to the real range.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[10].t says 'Gank for HER' about Veigar, who is male.
audit.why: champ-gender.js does not list veigar as female.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and dosFull[2].d promised a 'fifteen-second invitation' Event Horizon never offers.
audit.why: Two flagged by lint; the third is a magnitude with no source.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by denying stacks: every Baleful Strike he spends on you is AP he did not farm, and every death costs more.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Event Horizon spent means 14 to 20 seconds with no peel — that gap is the whole matchup, so use it.

edits.before: Veigar burns Event Horizon (Cage) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Bank the second Shunpo — a late cage behind you is the only way he kills you.

edits.before: That is Veigar’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.

edits.before: Gank for HER: any CC your jungler lands is a full string plus lotus — ping the dagger-banked windows and watch the chain react.
edits.after: Gank for HIM: Veigar has one cage and no mobility at all, so any jungler CC becomes a full string plus Lotus and a reset.

edits.before: Your Death Lotus beats his Primordial Burst maths early: he needs stacks + Deathcap-line AP for R to execute you, and at 6 he has neither. All-in on any wave where his E is on its 16-second cooldown.
edits.after: Your Death Lotus beats his Primordial Burst maths early: he needs stacks + Deathcap-line AP for R to execute you, and at 6 he has neither. All-in on any wave where Event Horizon is on its 17-second cooldown.

notes: Three full-layer chart rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet; all three aligned to Katarina with paired win[] entries and rewritten whys. Also corrected the overall rating: a 55.48% matchup with an all-Katarina chart was labelled EVEN. Two magnitude errors fixed: 'fifteen-second invitation' and a '16-second cooldown' for Event Horizon, which is 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s. The '300+ stacks', '575-range' and '1.2 seconds to land' figures in content.late and content.mid are not in the kit file — I did not repeat or extend them; they are listed in unverified. suspectNames flagged 'Phenomenal Evil' in wants.you[1] against 'Phenomenal Evil Power'; it is a common shorthand rather than a fabrication, and I left it.
